note: Hand-written (phase 4 design, lifecycle 4.5). The hash a sign-off carries: sha256Hex of the canonical JSON of { v: 1, noteId, encounterId, patientId (or null), noteTypeKey, noteTypeVersion, summary (the encounter's summary, or null), answers }, where answers are effectiveAnswers(definition, answers): the answers that count, blanks and refused answers left out, keys in UTF-16 code-unit order. noteTypeKey and noteTypeVersion are the definition's. A case's definition names one of forms-conformance.json's definitions. effective is what effectiveAnswers gives, key for key and in order; content is the canonical text that is hashed; hash is its lowercase hex SHA-256; sameHashAs names a case the hash must equal. services/api/src/encounters/content-hash.ts and apps/mobile/lib/encounters/content_hash.dart must give every content and hash; the readers are services/api/test/note-content-hash.test.ts and apps/mobile/test/encounters/content_hash_test.dart. The content and hash were worked out apart from both implementations.
